EKSScanning.Description: Allow the Wiz access role to automatically connect to EKS clusters that have public API endpoints

ExternalId.Description: Enter the External ID of the Wiz connector. This is a nonce that will be used by our service to assume the role in your account.

PermissionBoundaryPolicyName.Description: Optional permission boundary policy name which will be applied to the Wiz IAM access role. Please note that this permission boundary policy must already exist in every AWS account where the Wiz IAM roles will be deployed.

RoleARN.Description: Enter the AWS Trust Policy Role ARN for your Wiz data center. You can retrieve it from User Settings, Tenant in the Wiz portal.

RolePath.Description: The path for the IAM role. Useful for organizing roles under a specific path (e.g., /governance/). Must start and end with /.

S3AWSLogsScanning.Description: Enable retrieval of AWSLogs/* objects from S3 buckets

S3InventoryScanning.Description: Enable S3 inventory configuration scanning to discover and analyze S3 bucket inventory configurations. Disabled by default.

TerraformBucketScanning.Description: Enable Cloud to Code scanning of buckets containing Terraform infrastructure files

WizPolicyNameSuffix.Description: (Optional) Add a suffix to every IAM policy name. This is helpful in the event you are deploying multiple instances of the same stack

WizRoleName.Description: Enter the IAM role name that will be created in your AWS account, the default is WizAccess-Role

WizRootStackFilename.Description: The root stack filename from org deployments. Leave empty for standalone deployments.

WizRootStackId.Description: The root stack ID from org deployments. Leave empty for standalone deployments.
